creator: Alexander Terp
description:
GitHub issue #2 part 6 (Codex 0.162.1): `pane wait --until idle` answers idle for a new pane whose first prompt has not started running yet, so a director cannot tell "not started" from "done".

A Codex pane was started with `muster pane new --down --name '<name>' --run "<codex launch> '<first prompt: join a group, then end your turn>'"`, followed by `muster pane wait --pane <id> --until idle,blocked --timeout 180`. The wait printed `<id>  idle` at once, but `pane read` straight after showed Codex mid-turn on that first prompt ("Working (7s)"), and `msg who` did not list the new member yet. A second wait answered idle again once the turn really finished.

Holding a pane started with `--run` and a first prompt at working, or at a starting state, until its adapter reports the first turn would fix it. Failing that, `docs/cli/` could say that a wait after `pane new` must first wait `--until working`, as it already does for handing an idle agent work. The docs fallback is a workaround for every director, so the state fix is preferred. Check that the same gap exists for Claude Code, whose adapter reports differently.
title: pane wait reports a new pane idle while its first prompt is still running
